about: What the Pedro Pathing Visualizer draws for each .pp fixture in this folder: for every drivable segment, in lines order, the point and the robot heading at curve parameters 0, 0.05, ..., 1, read from the visualizer's own onion-layer heading function (src/utils/animation.ts) run on the file. completion is the visualizer's arc-length fraction of the segment at that parameter. Samples inside the visualizer's 12 per cent blend at the start of a later tangential or facing-point piecewise segment are left out, since the blend is a picture only. Generated by running the visualizer at visualizerCommit; no visualizer code is in this repository.
